caption: The drawing features a dark-skinned female figure with curly black hair, wearing round green earrings and a beaded necklace. The figure is dressed in a white, short-sleeved blouse with intricate, lacy details and a high neckline. The skirt is long, full, and white with a subtle blue tint, decorated at the hem with blue and green embroidered floral patterns. She wears pink shoes with flower decorations on the toes. Around her waist is a colorful plaid sash, predominantly in yellow, red, orange, white, and gray tones, tied on her right side and draping down her hip. The background of the drawing consists of a plain, beige paper with a slightly darker rectangular border framing the figure.
title: Doll
